{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: look for thousands separators
print("First 10 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for any non-numeric characters
print("\nAny non-numeric characters in revenue (excluding commas and decimal points)?")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', regex=True).any())

# Check for the presence of commas
print("\nNumber of rows with commas in revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())"}
